games.pickActivity: Choose an activity you would like to do.
games.savedOnDevice: Your progress is saved on this device.
games.offlineSaved: You are offline. Everything is saved on this device.
games.libraryEmpty: No activities are set up yet.
games.pausedNote: Take all the time you need. The activity is waiting for you.
games.leaveNote: That is completely fine. We will save what you have done.
games.comingSoon: This activity will be ready soon.
games.accuracySummary: You got {n} out of every 100 right. Lovely work.
games.spanSummary: You remembered {n} in a row. That is wonderful.
games.fatigueSummary: That is a good place to stop for today. You did well.
games.fatigueNote: You have done plenty for now. Let's finish here.
games.reminisceSummary: Thank you for sharing these memories.
games.calmTryNext: Good try. Let's begin the next one.
games.calmOkay: That's alright. Here comes the next one.

chimp.intro: Numbers will appear. Look at where they are. Then tap them in order, starting from 1.
chimp.study: Look at where the numbers are.
chimp.recall: Now tap them in order, from the smallest.
chimp.tapOneToStart: Tap number 1 when you are ready.

match.intro: Tap two cards to turn them over. Try to find the pairs that match.
match.tryAgain: Not a pair this time. Try again.

sequence.intro: Watch which buttons light up. Then tap them in the same order.

number.intro: Some numbers will show for a little while. Then tap them in the same order.
number.nowTap: Now tap the numbers in order.

reaction.intro: Watch the big box. When it turns green, tap it as soon as you can.
reaction.prompt: Tap the box when it turns green.
reaction.tooSoon: A little early. Wait for the green colour.

find.intro: You will be asked to find one thing in the picture. Tap it when you see it.

odd.intro: Look at the pictures. One of them does not belong with the others. Tap that one.

pattern.intro: Look at the row of shapes. Choose the shape that comes next.

word.intro: You will see a few words. Later you will be asked which ones you saw.
word.haveYouSeen: Have you seen this word before?

routine.intro: Put the steps of a daily routine in the right order by tapping them one by one.
routine.prompt: Put the steps of “{name}” in order.
routine.hint: Tap the steps in the order they happen.
routine.perfect: That is the right order. Well done.
routine.closeOne: You placed {n} of {total} in the right spot. Nicely done.

story.intro: Put the pictures of the story in the right order by tapping them one by one.
story.hint: Tap the pictures from what happens first to what happens last.
story.perfect: That is the right order. Lovely.
story.closeOne: You placed {n} of {total} in the right spot. Nicely done.

sound.intro: You will hear a sound. Tap the picture that matches it. You can listen again.

lane.intro: Look through some familiar pictures. There are no right or wrong answers here.
